Snap elapsed time onto a regular grid

snap_hours.Rd

Each plate reader keeps its own clock, so the elapsed time for what is meant to be the same nominal timepoint can drift by a second or more between plates and runs. Left as is, that drift makes exact-value grouping (for example group_by(hours) when pooling replicates across plates) fracture into several near-duplicate groups, which shows up downstream as an artificially jagged mean. Snapping elapsed hours onto the nominal read interval grid makes timepoints line up exactly.

Usage

snap_hours(hours, interval_hours = 1/3)

Arguments

hours

Numeric vector of elapsed time in hours.

interval_hours

Nominal read interval in hours. Defaults to 20 minutes (1/3).

Value

Numeric vector of hours, rounded to the nearest multiple of interval_hours.

Examples

snap_hours(c(0, 0.3336, 0.6661, 1.0003))
#> [1] 0.0000000 0.3333333 0.6666667 1.0000000
